items.title: StyleSmuggler: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE)
items.summary: A critical vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable servers, actively exploited in the wild. Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) for this flaw.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (Privilege Escalation)
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. This vulnerability has been actively exploited in the wild and was added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-71362, which could result in security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Security-Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Security-Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Security-Feature Bypass)
items.summary: A medium-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Privilege Escalation)
items.summary: A low-severity incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.
